sentences.ar: שני אנשים באו לג'וחא כשהיה שופט.
sentences.en: Two men came to Juha when he was a judge.
Juha said: you are right too.

sentences.ar: היא אמרה: הם לא יכולים שניהם לצדוק.
sentences.en: She said: they cannot both be right!
Juha said: and you are right as well.
